### `ConvoHopLocalStore` class

```swift
public actor ConvoHopLocalStore
```

A per-user cache of each conversation's newest messages and of the inbox, so screens can show content before the
network answers and while the device is offline.

The cache is never the source of truth. Show it, then load from the server and replace or merge. Entries written
under another data incarnation, and entries that fail to decode or validate, read as empty and are removed.

The store writes message text and properties to `storage` exactly as the server sent them. Use storage that your app
protects at rest, such as `FileRecoveryStorage` (excluded from backups and, on iOS, protected until the first unlock
after a restart), and call `removeAll()` when the user signs out. `removeAll()` finds conversations through an
index entry; to erase everything regardless of the index, delete the storage itself.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.messageLimit` property

```swift
public nonisolated let messageLimit: Int
```

The most messages kept per conversation. Newer messages push out older ones.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore` constructor

```swift
public init(client: ConvoHopClient, storage: any RecoveryStorage, messageLimit: Int = 200) throws
```

A store for `client`'s project, user and data incarnation. `messageLimit` must be 1...10000.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.messages` method

```swift
public func messages(in conversationId: String) async throws -> [Message]
```

A conversation's cached messages, oldest first.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.save` method

```swift
public func save(_ messages: [Message], in conversationId: String) async throws
```

Merges messages into a conversation's cache. A cached copy with a newer revision wins.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.replaceMessages` method

```swift
public func replaceMessages(_ messages: [Message], in conversationId: String) async throws
```

Replaces a conversation's cache, for example with a fresh page of its newest messages.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.remove` method

```swift
public func remove(messageIds: Set<String>, in conversationId: String) async throws
```

Removes some messages from a conversation's cache.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.removeMessages` method

```swift
public func removeMessages(in conversationId: String) async throws
```

Removes a conversation's cached messages, for example after the user leaves it or its history must be
resynchronized.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.inbox` method

```swift
public func inbox() async throws -> [InboxItem]
```

The cached inbox, in the order it was saved.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.saveInbox` method

```swift
public func saveInbox(_ items: [InboxItem]) async throws
```

Replaces the cached inbox.

#### `ConvoHopLocalStore.removeAll` method

```swift
public func removeAll() async throws
```

Removes every cached conversation and the inbox. Call it when the user signs out.

### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger` class

```swift
public final class ConvoHopNotificationLedger: @unchecked Sendable
```

Remembers the notification events this device handled and the rings that stopped.

Delivery is at least once and unordered: a redelivered event has the same `eventId`, and a cancellation can arrive
before its ring. Record each event once, and drop a ring the ledger reports as stopped.

Pass the same App Group suite in your app and its Notification Service Extension to share one ledger. Two processes
writing at the same moment can drop an entry, so treat the ledger as best effort. At sign-out, set `recipient` to
`ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody` and call `removeAll()`.

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger` constructor

```swift
public init(suiteName: String? = nil, capacity: Int = 512)
```

Parameters:

- `suiteName`: An App Group suite to share with your extensions, or `nil` for the app's standard defaults.
- `capacity`: How many event IDs and stopped rings to remember, at least 16.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.record` method

```swift
@discardableResult
public func record(_ notification: ConvoHopNotification) -> Bool
```

Records the event, and the stopped ring of a cancellation. Returns `false` when the event was already recorded.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.contains` method

```swift
public func contains(eventId: String) -> Bool
```

Whether the event was recorded.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.markStopped` method

```swift
public func markStopped(_ alert: ConvoHopCallAlert, reason: ConvoHopCallEndReason)
```

Records that a ring stopped, for example when your app ended it.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.stopReason` method

```swift
public func stopReason(alertId: String) -> ConvoHopCallEndReason?
```

Why the ring stopped, if a cancellation or stop was recorded for its `alertId`.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.isStopped` method

```swift
public func isStopped(_ alert: ConvoHopCallAlert, at now: Date = Date()) -> Bool
```

Whether the ring has stopped: a cancellation was recorded or its deadline has passed.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.recipient` property

```swift
public var recipient: ConvoHopPushRecipient { get set }
```

Whose pushes this device rings for and shows. `ConvoHopPushRecipient.any` until you set one.

It's stored in the ledger's suite, so a Notification Service Extension that shares the suite, and your app
after a relaunch, see it. A stored value this version can't read counts as `ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody`.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.removeAll` method

```swift
public func removeAll()
```

Forgets every event and ring. It keeps `recipient`.

### `ConvoHopOutbox` class

```swift
public actor ConvoHopOutbox
```

A durable queue of outgoing messages. It sends them in order per conversation, survives restarts and waits out
lost connectivity, so screens can show a message the moment the user sends it.

Each message keeps one request ID across its retries, so a resend after an uncertain outcome can't post it twice.
The outbox gives a message a new request ID on its own only after ConvoHop confirmed that it never saw the previous
one and every earlier attempt was refused outright. When an attempt's outcome stays unknown and ConvoHop hasn't seen
the request, the item becomes `State.unresolved`: the outbox rechecks it when connectivity returns, and
`resend(_:)` sends it again under a new request ID once the user or app accepts the small risk of a duplicate.

The queue is saved in the client's recovery storage, with the message text, so use storage your app protects at
rest. When the user signs out, await `stop()`, then call `removeAll()`. Without recovery storage the queue lives
in memory only.
Each user has one saved queue, so keep one outbox per user, in your app's process: outboxes that share a user's
queue, such as a share extension's, overwrite each other's unsent messages.

The outbox never renews the session. When a send fails because the session needs renewal, the whole queue pauses
and `pauseReason` holds the error: call `ConvoHopClient.refreshSession()`, then `resume()`.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.capacity` property

```swift
public nonisolated let capacity: Int
```

The most unsent items the queue holds.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.pauseReason` property

```swift
public private(set) var pauseReason: ConvoHopError?
```

The error that paused the queue. Fix its cause, then call `resume()`.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox` constructor

```swift
public init(
    client: ConvoHopClient,
    network: (any ConvoHopNetworkMonitor)? = nil,
    capacity: Int = 500
) throws
```

An outbox for `client`'s user. `capacity` must be 1...10000.

Without a `network` monitor, the outbox uses `NWPathMonitor`. It sends nothing until `start()`.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.start` method

```swift
public func start() async throws
```

Loads the saved queue and starts sending. Calling it again does nothing.

It throws `RECOVERY_STORAGE_FAILURE` when the saved queue can't be read. The outbox never drops it silently:
retry, or call `removeAll()` to discard it.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md) and [`communication.sendMessage`](../operations/communication/sendMessage.md).

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.stop` method

```swift
public func stop() async
```

Stops starting attempts, and returns once the outbox has stopped writing: the attempt and the lookup it had in
flight, and the saves they started, have settled. A send in flight finishes or times out first. The queue stays
saved, and `start()` sends it again.

On sign-out, await it before you clear the storage. Don't await it in your
`ConvoHopConfiguration.refreshSession` callback: requests wait while a renewal runs, so the send that `stop()`
waits for would wait for the callback.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.enqueue` method

```swift
@discardableResult
public func enqueue(
    _ text: String,
    to conversationId: String,
    props: JSONObject = [:]
) async throws -> Item
```

Queues a message and returns it at once, for an optimistic display.

If the queue can't be saved, the item stays queued in memory and `Item.failure` says why.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md) and [`communication.sendMessage`](../operations/communication/sendMessage.md).

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.items` method

```swift
public func items(in conversationId: String? = nil) async throws -> [Item]
```

Every item, or one conversation's items, in the order they were queued.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.snapshot` property

```swift
public var snapshot: Snapshot { get }
```

The queue now.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.updates` method

```swift
public func updates() -> AsyncStream<Snapshot>
```

The current snapshot, then one after each change. When updates arrive faster than you read them, you get the
newest.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.resume` method

```swift
public func resume()
```

Resumes a paused queue, for example after `ConvoHopClient.refreshSession()` succeeded.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md) and [`communication.sendMessage`](../operations/communication/sendMessage.md).

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.flush` method

```swift
public func flush()
```

Resumes the queue and tries every queued item now, even when the network monitor reports no network, for
example when the user pulls to refresh. It also rechecks unresolved items.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md) and [`communication.sendMessage`](../operations/communication/sendMessage.md).

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.resend` method

```swift
public func resend(_ id: UUID) async throws
```

Sends a failed or unresolved item again under a new request ID, keeping its place in the queue.

For an unresolved item, it first asks ConvoHop about the previous request ID and marks the item sent if
ConvoHop stored it. If an earlier attempt is still in transit, a resend can post the message twice.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md) and [`communication.sendMessage`](../operations/communication/sendMessage.md).

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.discard` method

```swift
@discardableResult
public func discard(_ id: UUID) async throws -> Bool
```

Removes an item that isn't being sent. It returns `false` when the item is gone or in flight.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.removeAll` method

```swift
public func removeAll() async throws
```

Removes every item and the saved queue. Call it when the user signs out, or to discard a saved queue that
can't be read. An attempt in flight still finishes; await `stop()` first to wait for it.

### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter` class

```swift
public actor ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter
```

Reports, without flooding ConvoHop, how far this user has read one conversation.

Call `markRead(through:)` whenever the user sees newer messages. The reporter only moves forward, waits a second
to combine calls, and keeps one report in flight. It reads this user's membership when it needs it, and reads it
again once when ConvoHop answers `REVISION_CONFLICT`, for example after the user's visibility changed.

#### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter.conversationId` property

```swift
public nonisolated let conversationId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter.confirmedThrough` property

```swift
public private(set) var confirmedThrough: String?
```

The newest sequence ConvoHop confirmed as read by this user, under the current membership.

#### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter.lastError` property

```swift
public private(set) var lastError: (any Error)?
```

The latest failure, cleared by the next confirmed report.

#### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter` constructor

```swift
public init(client: ConvoHopClient, conversationId: String, delay: Int = 1_000) throws
```

A reporter that waits `delay` milliseconds (0...60000) to combine calls.

#### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter.markRead` method

```swift
public func markRead(through sequence: String) throws
```

Notes that this user read the conversation through `sequence`. Older sequences change nothing.

Sends [`communication.getConversation`](../operations/communication/getConversation.md) and [`communication.reportReceipt`](../operations/communication/reportReceipt.md).

#### `ConvoHopReadReceiptReporter.update` method

```swift
public func update(membership: Member)
```

Uses `membership` for the next reports, for example from `ConvoHopClient.getConversation(_:)`. A new
membership or visibility epoch starts a new read position.

### `ConvoHopSessionRefreshSchedule` class

```swift
public final class ConvoHopSessionRefreshSchedule: Sendable
```

A session renewal schedule from `ConvoHopClient.scheduleSessionRefresh(lead:onRefreshed:onError:)`. Keep it
while the session should stay renewed; cancel or release it to stop.

#### `ConvoHopSessionRefreshSchedule.cancel` method

```swift
public func cancel()
```

Stops renewal. A renewal in progress still completes, but its callbacks don't run.

### `ConvoHopTypingIndicator` class

```swift
public actor ConvoHopTypingIndicator
```

Tells other members, without flooding ConvoHop, whether this user is typing in one conversation.

Call `textChanged()` on every edit of the composer. The indicator reports typing at most every 3 seconds and
reports that typing stopped after 5 seconds without edits. Call `stop()` when the user sends or leaves the screen.

Typing is a best-effort signal: ConvoHop never stores or resends it, and the indicator drops failures. When the
authority's capabilities turn typing off, the indicator sends nothing. ConvoHop's client API doesn't deliver other
members' typing state yet, so this type only sends.

#### `ConvoHopTypingIndicator.conversationId` property

```swift
public nonisolated let conversationId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopTypingIndicator` constructor

```swift
public init(client: ConvoHopClient, conversationId: String) throws
```

#### `ConvoHopTypingIndicator.isTyping` property

```swift
public var isTyping: Bool { get }
```

Whether the indicator reported that this user is typing and hasn't reported stopping yet.

#### `ConvoHopTypingIndicator.textChanged` method

```swift
public func textChanged()
```

Notes an edit of the composer.

Sends [`communication.capabilities`](../operations/communication/capabilities.md) and [`communication.typing`](../operations/communication/typing.md).

#### `ConvoHopTypingIndicator.stop` method

```swift
public func stop()
```

Reports that this user stopped typing, if the indicator reported typing.

Sends [`communication.typing`](../operations/communication/typing.md).

### `FileRecoveryStorage` class

```swift
public actor FileRecoveryStorage: RecoveryStorage
```

Recovery storage in files, one file per key, written atomically.

On Apple platforms, the directory is excluded from backups because recovery records belong to one device's session.
On iOS, files stay readable after the first unlock following a restart, so background work and call handling can
resume requests while the device is locked.

#### `FileRecoveryStorage.directory` property

```swift
public nonisolated let directory: URL
```

#### `FileRecoveryStorage` constructor

```swift
public init(directory: URL) throws
```

Uses `directory`, creating it when needed.

```swift
    subdirectory: String = "ConvoHop"
) throws -> FileRecoveryStorage
```

Storage in `Application Support/<subdirectory>` of the app's container.

#### `FileRecoveryStorage.appGroup` static method

```swift
public static func appGroup(
    _ identifier: String,
    subdirectory: String = "ConvoHop"
) throws -> FileRecoveryStorage
```

Storage in an App Group container, shared with your app extensions.

#### `FileRecoveryStorage.value` method

```swift
public func value(forKey key: String) throws -> String?
```

#### `FileRecoveryStorage.setValue` method

```swift
public func setValue(_ value: String, forKey key: String) throws
```

#### `FileRecoveryStorage.removeValue` method

```swift
public func removeValue(forKey key: String) throws
```

### `LiveParticipationHandle` class

```swift
public actor LiveParticipationHandle
```

This user's participation in a call: native media credentials, connection and leave.

#### `LiveParticipationHandle.live` property

```swift
public nonisolated let live: LiveSessionHandle
```

#### `LiveParticipationHandle.snapshot` property

```swift
public nonisolated let snapshot: LiveParticipation
```

The participation as it was when this handle was created.

#### `LiveParticipationHandle.participationId` property

```swift
public nonisolated let participationId: String
```

#### `LiveParticipationHandle.get` method

```swift
public func get() async throws -> LiveParticipation
```

The participation's current state. Throws `PARTICIPATION_MISMATCH` once it is no longer current.

Sends [`communication.liveSession`](../operations/communication/liveSession.md).

#### `LiveParticipationHandle.connect` method

```swift
public func connect(
    _ options: ConvoHopMediaOptions,
    requestId: String? = nil
) async throws -> MediaConnection
```

Connects native media with a fresh single-use credential. Connecting never starts capture.

Concurrent calls share one attempt, and a connected connection is returned as is. A failed connection throws
`MEDIA_CONNECT_FAILED` and keeps the reservation: connect again, which resolves the old credential first, or
leave.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md), [`communication.liveSession`](../operations/communication/liveSession.md) and [`communication.liveSessionCredentials`](../operations/communication/liveSessionCredentials.md).

#### `LiveParticipationHandle.leave` method

```swift
public func leave(requestId: String? = nil) async throws -> LiveSessionLeft
```

Leaves the call and disconnects media. Keep `requestId` to resolve an uncertain leave.

Sends [`communication.leaveLiveSession`](../operations/communication/leaveLiveSession.md).

### `MediaConnection` class

```swift
public actor MediaConnection
```

One native media connection of a participation. Its credential admits exactly one connection.

A dropped connection resumes within LiveKit while its token allows; `resuming` is true meanwhile. A resume must
keep the admitted connection: anything else closes it. Then connect again with fresh credentials:
call `reconnect()`.

#### `MediaConnection.participation` property

```swift
public nonisolated let participation: LiveParticipationHandle
```

#### `MediaConnection.room` property

```swift
public nonisolated let room: any ConvoHopMediaRoom
```

The room, for rendering tracks and reading statistics. `ConvoHopLiveKit`'s room exposes LiveKit's `Room`.

#### `MediaConnection.options` property

```swift
public nonisolated let options: ConvoHopMediaOptions
```

#### `MediaConnection.nativeConnectionId` property

```swift
public private(set) var nativeConnectionId: String?
```

The media server's ID for this connection, once connected.

#### `MediaConnection.resuming` property

```swift
public private(set) var resuming: Bool
```

Whether the room is resuming this connection after a network interruption.

#### `MediaConnection.reconnect` method

```swift
public func reconnect() async throws -> MediaConnection
```

Replaces a dropped connection with a new one, using fresh credentials. Concurrent calls share one attempt.

Sends [`communication.resolveRequest`](../operations/communication/resolveRequest.md), [`communication.liveSession`](../operations/communication/liveSession.md) and [`communication.liveSessionCredentials`](../operations/communication/liveSessionCredentials.md).

#### `MediaConnection.connected` property

```swift
public var connected: Bool { get }
```

Whether media is connected and not closed.

#### `MediaConnection.microphone` method

```swift
public func microphone(_ enabled: Bool) async throws
```

Starts or stops the microphone. Ask for microphone permission first.

#### `MediaConnection.camera` method

```swift
public func camera(_ enabled: Bool) async throws
```

Starts or stops the camera. Ask for camera permission first.

#### `MediaConnection.disconnect` method

```swift
public func disconnect() async
```

Disconnects for good. The participation stays joined until you leave it.

### `ConvoHopError` struct

```swift
public struct ConvoHopError: Error, Sendable, CustomStringConvertible, LocalizedError
```

An error from ConvoHop or from the SDK's own protocol checks.

Classify errors by `code`. `outcome` says whether a mutation may have taken effect; an `unknown` outcome
is never a rejection. Messages never contain credentials.

#### `ConvoHopError.code` property

```swift
public let code: ConvoHopErrorCode
```

#### `ConvoHopError.requestId` property

```swift
public let requestId: String
```

The request ID of the failed request, or a fresh ID for failures that belong to no request.

#### `ConvoHopError.outcome` property

```swift
public let outcome: ConvoHopOutcome
```

#### `ConvoHopError.status` property

```swift
public let status: Int?
```

The HTTP-equivalent status, or `nil` when no status applies, for example after a transport failure.

#### `ConvoHopError.message` property

```swift
public let message: String
```

#### `ConvoHopError.retryAfter` property

```swift
public let retryAfter: Int?
```

Whole seconds to wait before resending the same request, when the authority sent a delay (for example with
`RATE_LIMITED`). The SDK never resends a call you made, but the work it retries by itself waits at least this
long: stream reconnects, a renewal schedule's initialization and queued messages.

#### `ConvoHopError.underlyingError` property

```swift
public let underlyingError: (any Error)?
```

The error that caused this one, such as a failed recovery write or session refresh callback.

#### `ConvoHopError` constructor

```swift
public init(
    code: ConvoHopErrorCode,
    requestId: String,
    outcome: ConvoHopOutcome,
    status: Int?,
    message: String,
    retryAfter: Int? = nil,
    underlyingError: (any Error)? = nil
)
```

#### `ConvoHopError.scope` property

```swift
public var scope: String? { get }
```

For `SCOPE_REQUIRED`, the missing backend-key scope when the message names it in the documented wording.

#### `ConvoHopError.isRetryable` property

```swift
public var isRetryable: Bool { get }
```

Whether the documented code may succeed when resent with the same request ID.

#### `ConvoHopError.description` property

```swift
public var description: String { get }
```

#### `ConvoHopError.errorDescription` property

```swift
public var errorDescription: String? { get }
```

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.pageItemTooLarge` static property


#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.participationMismatch` static property

```swift
public static let participationMismatch = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "PARTICIPATION_MISMATCH")
```

The participation does not belong to the caller or the current live session generation.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.planLimitExceeded` static property

```swift
public static let planLimitExceeded = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
```

The plan does not permit the resource or feature. extensions.planLimit names the limit and extensions.limit holds the plan's value. Change the plan or the limit before trying again.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.quotaExceeded` static property

```swift
public static let quotaExceeded = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED")
```

A hard usage quota refused new work until the quota period ends. extensions.meter, extensions.limit and extensions.periodEnd describe the quota, and extensions.retryAfter (HTTP Retry-After) counts the seconds until it resets. Work already in progress continues.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.rateLimited` static property

```swift
public static let rateLimited = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RATE_LIMITED")
```

A per-second rate limit refused the request before it had any effect. Wait extensions.retryAfter seconds (HTTP Retry-After), then resend the request with the same requestId.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.recoveryLimit` static property

```swift
public static let recoveryLimit = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RECOVERY_LIMIT")
```

The SDK's recovery store already holds 128 mutation records that are not final, so the new request was not sent. Retry or resolve outstanding requests, then send it again.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.recoveryStorageFailure` static property

```swift
public static let recoveryStorageFailure = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RECOVERY_STORAGE_FAILURE")
```

Caller-provided recovery storage did not confirm durability. Keep the original request and its outcome.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.requestExpired` static property

```swift
public static let requestExpired = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "REQUEST_EXPIRED")
```

The original request is too old to replay.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.requestTooLarge` static property

```swift
public static let requestTooLarge = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE")
```

The request body exceeds the size limit.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.resolutionRequired` static property

```swift
public static let resolutionRequired = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RESOLUTION_REQUIRED")
```

The outcome is still unresolved and the retry budget is spent. Resolve the original request before continuing.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.responseTooLarge` static property

```swift
public static let responseTooLarge = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
```

The response exceeds the size limit.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.resyncRequired` static property

```swift
public static let resyncRequired = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RESYNC_REQUIRED")
```

The subscription cannot continue. Replay from the last applied cursor.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.retryExhausted` static property

```swift
public static let retryExhausted = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "RETRY_EXHAUSTED")
```

The authority exhausted its internal retry budget. Retry later with the same requestId.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.revisionConflict` static property

```swift
public static let revisionConflict = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "REVISION_CONFLICT")
```

The expected revision or epoch is stale. Read the current state and retry with a new request.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.scopeRequired` static property

The backend key lacks a scope this operation requires. The message names the scope.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.sessionRefreshFailed` static property


The application session refresh callback failed.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.sessionRefreshRejected` static property

```swift
public static let sessionRefreshRequired = ConvoHopErrorCode(rawValue: "SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED")
```

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.sessionRefreshUnverified` static property


#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.transportUnknown` static property

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.unauthenticated` static property


The credential is missing, invalid or expired.

#### `ConvoHopErrorCode.wrongRegion` static property

### `ConvoHopHTTPResponse` struct

Called when the room lost its connection and is resuming it.

### `ConvoHopNotification` struct

```swift
public struct ConvoHopNotification: Sendable, Hashable
```

A ConvoHop notification event from an APNs, PushKit or FCM payload.

Events carry identifiers and, only when the project opts in to message previews, visible text. Delivery is at
least once and unordered: deduplicate on `eventId` with `ConvoHopNotificationLedger`.

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.eventId` property

```swift
public let eventId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.eventType` property

```swift
public let eventType: String
```

`notification.message`, `notification.call` or `notification.callCancelled`.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.projectId` property

```swift
public let projectId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.recipientId` property

```swift
public let recipientId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.conversationId` property

```swift
public let conversationId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.senderId` property

```swift
public let senderId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.occurredAt` property

```swift
public let occurredAt: Date
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.title` property

```swift
public let title: String?
```

The visible title, if the push carries one.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.body` property

```swift
public let body: String?
```

The visible body, if the push carries one: your backend's text or, when the project opts in, the message
preview. Absent by default.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.kind` property

```swift
public let kind: Kind
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.callAlert` property

```swift
public var callAlert: ConvoHopCallAlert? { get }
```

The ring, for calls and cancellations.

#### `ConvoHopNotification` constructor

```swift
public init?(userInfo: [AnyHashable: Any])
public init(jsonObject: Any) throws
public init(jsonData: Data) throws
```

Reads the `convohop` object of a push's `userInfo`, and the visible text of an APNs alert.

Returns `nil` when the push has no valid `convohop` object or it isn't a notification event this SDK supports.
Fields the contract doesn't define are ignored.

Validates a `convohop` object: a dictionary, or its JSON text as FCM data carries it.

Validates the JSON text of a `convohop` object.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.parse` static method

```swift
public static func parse(userInfo: [AnyHashable: Any]) throws -> ConvoHopNotification?
```

Reads a push's `userInfo` like `init(userInfo:)`, but throws `ConvoHopPushPayloadError` when the `convohop`
object is malformed.

Returns `nil` when the push has no `convohop` object or its event type isn't one this SDK supports.

### `ConvoHopOutcome` struct

```swift
public struct ConvoHopOutcome: RawRepresentable, Hashable, Sendable, CustomStringConvertible
```

What is known about the effect of a failed request.

Values that this list doesn't name can still arrive from the authority, so handle unknown outcomes.

#### `ConvoHopOutcome.rawValue` property

```swift
public let rawValue: String
```

#### `ConvoHopOutcome` constructor

```swift
public init(rawValue: String)
```

#### `ConvoHopOutcome.rejected` static property

```swift
public static let rejected = ConvoHopOutcome(rawValue: "rejected")
```

The request had no effect.

#### `ConvoHopOutcome.unknown` static property

```swift
public static let unknown = ConvoHopOutcome(rawValue: "unknown")
```

The request may or may not have taken effect. Resolve or retry it with the same request ID.

#### `ConvoHopOutcome.committed` static property

```swift
public static let committed = ConvoHopOutcome(rawValue: "committed")
```

The request committed.

#### `ConvoHopOutcome.accepted` static property

```swift
public static let accepted = ConvoHopOutcome(rawValue: "accepted")
```

The request was accepted as a long-running operation.

#### `ConvoHopOutcome.description` property

```swift
public var description: String { get }
```

### `GraphQLIdempotency` struct

```swift
public struct GraphQLIdempotency: Hashable, Sendable
```

Retry and resolution rules of an idempotency class.

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.name` property

```swift
public let name: String
```

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.retry` property

```swift
public let retry: GraphQLRetry
```

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.resolvable` property

```swift
public let resolvable: Bool
```

Whether an unknown outcome can be resolved by looking up the request.

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.retryBudget` property

```swift
public let retryBudget: GraphQLRetryBudget?
```

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.ephemeral` static property

```swift
public static let ephemeral = GraphQLIdempotency(name: "ephemeral", retry: .none, resolvable: false, retryBudget: nil)
```

Transient signal. Not deduplicated or retried; send a fresh signal instead.

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.idempotent` static property

```swift
public static let idempotent = GraphQLIdempotency(name: "idempotent", retry: .sameRequest, resolvable: true, retryBudget: GraphQLRetryBudget(maxAttempts: 3, windowMs: 60000))
```

Retry with the same requestId and identical input within the retry budget. The authority deduplicates by requestId; resolve an unknown outcome with resolveRequest.

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.permitBound` static property

```swift
public static let permitBound = GraphQLIdempotency(name: "permitBound", retry: .sameRequest, resolvable: false, retryBudget: GraphQLRetryBudget(maxAttempts: 3, windowMs: 60000))
```

Authorized by a single-delivery permit. Retry with the same requestId and permit; outcomes cannot be resolved by lookup.

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.safe` static property

```swift
public static let safe = GraphQLIdempotency(name: "safe", retry: .`repeat`, resolvable: false, retryBudget: nil)
```

Read-only. Repeat freely; each attempt may use a new requestId.

#### `GraphQLIdempotency.singleUse` static property

```swift
public static let singleUse = GraphQLIdempotency(name: "singleUse", retry: .sameRequest, resolvable: true, retryBudget: GraphQLRetryBudget(maxAttempts: 3, windowMs: 60000))
```

Like idempotent, but the result carries a short-lived credential for one connection. Request a new one instead of reusing an expired result.

### `LiveAction` struct

```swift
public struct LiveAction: Sendable
```

A call start or end that completes asynchronously.

#### `LiveAction.client` property

```swift
public let client: ConvoHopClient
```

#### `LiveAction.operationId` property

```swift
public let operationId: String
```

#### `LiveAction.liveSessionId` property

```swift
public let liveSessionId: String
```

#### `LiveAction.kind` property

```swift
public let kind: LiveOperationKind
```

#### `LiveAction.requestId` property

```swift
public let requestId: String
```

The request ID of the command that created the action.

#### `LiveAction.get` method

```swift
public func get() async throws -> LiveSessionOperation
```

The action's current state.

Sends [`communication.liveSessionOperation`](../operations/communication/liveSessionOperation.md).

#### `LiveAction.completed` method

```swift
public func completed(timeout: TimeInterval = 45) async throws -> LiveSessionOperationCompletion
```

Polls every 500 ms until the action completes, fails or `timeout` passes.

A timeout throws `RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`: keep the operation ID and query it again. Elapsed time is not cutoff.
Cancelling the calling task stops polling.

Sends [`communication.liveSessionOperation`](../operations/communication/liveSessionOperation.md).

### `LiveSessionAlerts` struct

```swift
public struct LiveSessionAlerts: Sendable
```

Rings for one call.

#### `LiveSessionAlerts.live` property

```swift

```

#### `LiveSessionAlerts.send` method

```swift
public func send(_ principalIds: [String], requestId: String? = nil) async throws -> LiveAlertBatch
```

Rings `principalIds`. Each gets a `notification.call` event, which your backend turns into a push.

Sends [`communication.alertLiveSession`](../operations/communication/alertLiveSession.md).

```swift
public var requestId: String { get }
```

#### `LiveStartOperation.ready` method

```swift
public func ready(timeout: TimeInterval = 45) async throws -> LiveSessionHandle
```

Waits until the call is ready, then returns its handle.

Sends [`communication.liveSession`](../operations/communication/liveSession.md) and [`communication.liveSessionOperation`](../operations/communication/liveSessionOperation.md).

```swift
)
```

## Interfaces

### `ConvoHopHTTPClient` interface

```swift
public protocol ConvoHopHTTPClient: Sendable
```

Sends HTTP requests. Throw when no complete response arrived; the SDK reports that as `TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN`.

Implementations must not follow redirects, send cookies or use caches. Return a redirect response as it is: the
SDK reports it as `TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN`, because another location's answer isn't the authority's.

#### `ConvoHopHTTPClient.send` method

```swift
func send(_ request: ConvoHopHTTPRequest) async throws -> ConvoHopHTTPResponse
```

### `ConvoHopMediaRoom` interface

```swift
public protocol ConvoHopMediaRoom: AnyObject, Sendable
```

A native media room that joins one LiveKit room with a single-use token.

`ConvoHopLiveKit` provides `ConvoHopMediaRoom` for the official LiveKit Swift SDK. Implement it yourself only to
wrap another LiveKit client.

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoom.connect` method

```swift
func connect(
    url: URL,
    token: String,
    iceTransportPolicy: ConvoHopICETransportPolicy,
    onEvent: @escaping @Sendable (ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent) -> Void
) async throws -> String
```

Connects once with `token`, without capture. Returns the local participant's server ID.

Report the connection's events through `onEvent`, in order: `ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent.resuming` and
`ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent.resumed(participantId:)` around each resume, and
`ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent.disconnected` at most once, when the room disconnects without `disconnect()`. Never
log or store the token, and never connect with it again.

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoom.setMicrophone` method

```swift
func setMicrophone(enabled: Bool) async throws
```

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoom.setCamera` method

```swift
func setCamera(enabled: Bool) async throws
```

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoom.disconnect` method

```swift
func disconnect() async
```

Disconnects, if connected, and releases the room's tracks, renderers and delegates. Reports no event.

The SDK also calls it after the room disconnected by itself, so it must be safe to call more than once.

### `ConvoHopNetworkMonitor` interface

```swift
public protocol ConvoHopNetworkMonitor: Sendable
```

Reports whether the device has a usable network path.

`ConvoHopOutbox` holds queued messages while the device is offline. Pass your own monitor when your app already
tracks connectivity, or in tests.

#### `ConvoHopNetworkMonitor.reachability` method

```swift
func reachability() -> AsyncStream<Bool>
```

Reachability now and after each change. Each call returns a new sequence.

### `ConvoHopWebSocket` interface

```swift
public protocol ConvoHopWebSocket: AnyObject, Sendable
```

One realtime connection. Implementations deliver events in order and finish `events` after `closed`.

#### `ConvoHopWebSocket.events` property

```swift
var events: AsyncStream<ConvoHopWebSocketEvent> { get }
```

#### `ConvoHopWebSocket.send` method

```swift
func send(_ text: String)
```

#### `ConvoHopWebSocket.close` method

```swift
func close(code: Int)
```

Closes the connection. It reports `closed` with `code` and sends no later events.

### `ConvoHopWebSocketFactory` interface

```swift
public protocol ConvoHopWebSocketFactory: Sendable
```

Opens realtime connections. Tests and apps with their own networking stack can supply one.

#### `ConvoHopWebSocketFactory.connect` method

```swift
func connect(to url: URL, subprotocol: String) -> any ConvoHopWebSocket
```

### `RecoveryStorage` interface

```swift
public protocol RecoveryStorage: Sendable
```

Durable storage for mutation recovery records and realtime replay cursors.

The SDK stores JSON text that never contains credentials. A write must be durable when it returns. The SDK
reports a failed write as `RECOVERY_STORAGE_FAILURE` and keeps the original request identity, so the app can
resolve the request later.

#### `RecoveryStorage.value` method

```swift
func value(forKey key: String) async throws -> String?
```

#### `RecoveryStorage.setValue` method

```swift
func setValue(_ value: String, forKey key: String) async throws
```

#### `RecoveryStorage.removeValue` method

```swift
func removeValue(forKey key: String) async throws
```

## Enums

### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Entry` enum

```swift
public enum Entry: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable
```

A row of the conversation.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Entry.message` case

```swift
case message(Message)
```

A message ConvoHop stored.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Entry.outgoing` case

```swift
case outgoing(ConvoHopOutbox.Item)
```

A message in the outbox that ConvoHop hasn't confirmed yet, or that isn't loaded yet.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Entry.id` property

```swift
public var id: String { get }
```

### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase` enum

```swift
public enum Phase: Hashable, Sendable
```

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.idle` case

```swift
case idle
```

Not started, or stopped.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.loading` case

```swift
case loading
```

Loading the conversation.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.live` case

```swift
case live
```

Following the conversation's events.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.retrying` case

```swift
case retrying
```

Waiting to try again. `ConvoHopConversationModel.lastError` says why; when it is a session error,
renew the session. `ConvoHopConversationModel.start()` tries again at once.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.resyncRequired` case

```swift
case resyncRequired
```

This user's authorized history changed and the model cleared its messages. Call
`ConvoHopConversationModel.resync()`.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.left` case

```swift
case left
```

This user left the conversation.

#### `ConvoHopConversationModel.Phase.failed` case

```swift
case failed
```

The model stopped because of `ConvoHopConversationModel.lastError`. Call
`ConvoHopConversationModel.start()` to try again.

### `ConvoHopDeliveredNotifications` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopDeliveredNotifications
```

Removes notifications that iOS or macOS already shows for a ring.

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopDeliveredNotifications.remove` static method

```swift
public static func remove(alertId: String) async
```

Removes delivered notifications whose `convohop.alertId` is `alertId`.

A ring the user answered or declined gets no push, so an incoming-call alert stays until your app removes it.

### `ConvoHopICETransportPolicy` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopICETransportPolicy: String, Sendable
```

The ICE candidates a media connection may use.

#### `ConvoHopICETransportPolicy.all` case

```swift
case all
```

Direct and relayed candidates.

#### `ConvoHopICETransportPolicy.relay` case

```swift
case relay
```

Relayed candidates only: TURN hides the device's addresses.

### `ConvoHopLiveError` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopLiveError: Error, Sendable, Equatable, CustomStringConvertible, LocalizedError
```

A failure of the call layer's own rules, before or instead of a request.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.leaveRequested` case

```swift
case leaveRequested
```

This participation was left. Resolve the leave's cutoff and join again.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.leftDuringConnection` case

```swift
case leftDuringConnection
```

The participation was left while media was connecting; the new connection was closed.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.leaveIdentityConflict` case

```swift
case leaveIdentityConflict
```

A leave is already recorded with another request ID. Resolve it first.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.connectionClosed` case

```swift
case connectionClosed
```

The connection was closed deliberately, so it can't reconnect. Connect the participation again.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.closedDuringReconnect` case

```swift
case closedDuringReconnect
```

The connection was closed while it reconnected.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.freshCredentialsRequired` case

```swift
case freshCredentialsRequired
```

The media lease expired before the connection. Connect again for fresh credentials.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.microphoneNotAuthorized` case

```swift
case microphoneNotAuthorized
```

The participation may not publish a microphone, or media isn't connected.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.cameraNotAuthorized` case

```swift
case cameraNotAuthorized
```

The participation may not publish a camera, or media isn't connected.

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.description` property

```swift
public var description: String { get }
```

#### `ConvoHopLiveError.errorDescription` property

```swift
public var errorDescription: String? { get }
```

### `ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent: Sendable, Equatable
```

What a media room reports about the connection it made.

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent.resuming` case

```swift
case resuming
```

The room lost its connection and is resuming it with the current or a server-refreshed token.

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent.resumed` case

```swift
case resumed(participantId: String?)
```

The room resumed. `participantId` is the local participant's server ID after the resume.

#### `ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent.disconnected` case

```swift
case disconnected
```

The room disconnected without `ConvoHopMediaRoom.disconnect()`.

### `ConvoHopNotification.Kind` enum

```swift
public enum Kind: Sendable, Hashable
```

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.Kind.message` case

```swift
case message(messageId: String)
```

A new message. Open the conversation; fetch the message with the user's session.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.Kind.call` case

```swift
case call(ConvoHopCallAlert)
```

An incoming call. On iOS, report it to CallKit.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.Kind.callCancelled` case

```swift
case callCancelled(ConvoHopCallAlert, reason: ConvoHopCallEndReason)
```

A ring stopped. `reason` `ConvoHopCallEndReason.ended` and `ConvoHopCallEndReason.expired` are missed
calls.

### `ConvoHopNotificationTarget` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopNotificationTarget: Sendable
```

Where a ConvoHop notification leads, for this session's user.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationTarget.message` case

```swift
case message(ConversationHandle, messageId: String)
```

A new message. Open the conversation at the message, and fetch it with `ConversationMessages.get(_:)`:
payloads carry no message text unless the project opts in to previews.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationTarget.call` case

```swift
case call(ConversationHandle, ConvoHopCallAlert)
```

An incoming call. Join it with `ConvoHopClient.liveSession(_:)`, or ring through `ConvoHopCalls` on iOS.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationTarget.callCancelled` case

```swift
case callCancelled(ConversationHandle, ConvoHopCallAlert, reason: ConvoHopCallEndReason)
```

A ring stopped. `ConvoHopCallEndReason.isMissedCall` says whether to show a missed call.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationTarget.conversation` property

```swift
public var conversation: ConversationHandle { get }
```

The conversation the notification belongs to.

### `ConvoHopOperations` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopOperations
```

The operations a client may send, keyed in the catalog by operation ID.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationCapabilities` static property

```swift
public static let communicationCapabilities: GraphQLOperation<NoInput, CapabilitiesReply>
```

Describe the features, limits and API model the authority supports.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationRoute` static property

```swift
public static let communicationRoute: GraphQLOperation<NoInput, RouteReply>
```

Return the signed route: project incarnation, serving epoch and realtime endpoint. Call it before other communication operations and again after WRONG_REGION.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationCurrentSession` static property

```swift
public static let communicationCurrentSession: GraphQLOperation<NoInput, CurrentSessionReply>
```

Return the calling user session.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationGetConversation` static property

```swift
public static let communicationGetConversation: GraphQLOperation<GetConversationRequestInput, GetConversationReply>
```

Read a conversation.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationMembers` static property

```swift
public static let communicationMembers: GraphQLOperation<MembersRequestInput, MembersReply>
```

List the members of a conversation.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationMessages` static property

```swift
public static let communicationMessages: GraphQLOperation<MessagesRequestInput, MessagesReply>
```

List the messages of a conversation, newest first. A backend key reads the full history, or the history visible to the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationGetMessage` static property

```swift
public static let communicationGetMessage: GraphQLOperation<GetMessageRequestInput, GetMessageReply>
```

Read one message. A backend key reads any message, or reads as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationEvents` static property

```swift
public static let communicationEvents: GraphQLOperation<EventsRequestInput, EventsReply>
```

Replay committed conversation events after a cursor, in sequence order.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationReceipts` static property

```swift
public static let communicationReceipts: GraphQLOperation<ReceiptsRequestInput, ReceiptsReply>
```

List the delivery and read receipts of a conversation.

#### `ConvoHopOperations.communicationInbox` static property

### `ConvoHopOutbox.State` enum

```swift
public enum State: String, Hashable, Sendable, Codable
```

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.State.queued` case

```swift
case queued
```

Waiting to be sent, or to be retried after a delay.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.State.sending` case

```swift
case sending
```

An attempt is in flight.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.State.sent` case

```swift
case sent
```

ConvoHop stored the message. Sent items leave the queue after a minute.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.State.failed` case

```swift
case failed
```

ConvoHop refused the message. `ConvoHopOutbox.resend(_:)` or `ConvoHopOutbox.discard(_:)` it.

#### `ConvoHopOutbox.State.unresolved` case

```swift
case unresolved
```

The outbox couldn't learn whether ConvoHop stored the message. It rechecks when connectivity returns;
`ConvoHopOutbox.resend(_:)` or `ConvoHopOutbox.discard(_:)` it.

### `ConvoHopPushPayloadError` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopPushPayloadError: Error, Sendable, Equatable, CustomStringConvertible, LocalizedError
```

A payload that isn't a ConvoHop notification event under the push payload contract.

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopPushPayloadError.missing` case

```swift
case missing
```

The payload has no `convohop` object.

#### `ConvoHopPushPayloadError.notAnObject` case

```swift
case notAnObject
```

`convohop` isn't a JSON object.

#### `ConvoHopPushPayloadError.unsupportedEventType` case

```swift
case unsupportedEventType(String)
```

An event type this SDK doesn't know. Ignore the push.

#### `ConvoHopPushPayloadError.invalidField` case

```swift
case invalidField(String)
```

A field the event type requires is missing or malformed.

### `ConvoHopPushRecipient` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopPushRecipient: Sendable, Hashable
```

Whose ConvoHop pushes this device rings for and shows.

Set it at sign-in to the signed-in user, and to `nobody` at sign-out: your backend can still hold the device's
tokens, and their pushes keep arriving. Store it with `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.recipient`, or set
`ConvoHopCalls.recipient`, so your Notification Service Extension and a relaunch for a VoIP push see it.

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.any` case

```swift
case any
```

Every ConvoHop push. The default until you set a recipient.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.only` case

```swift
case only(projectId: String, recipientId: String)
```

Only pushes for this user in this project.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody` case

```swift
case nobody
```

No ConvoHop push, for example after sign-out.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.accepts` method

```swift
public func accepts(_ notification: ConvoHopNotification) -> Bool
```

Whether the push is for this recipient.

### `ConvoHopPushRegistration` enum

```swift
@MainActor
public enum ConvoHopPushRegistration
```

Asks to show notifications and registers the app with APNs.

ConvoHop never stores device tokens. Send the token from
`application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)` to your backend as
`ConvoHopPushToken.hex(_:)`. Your backend delivers the push requests it builds from ConvoHop's notification
webhooks. For calls, send your backend the VoIP token from `ConvoHopCalls` too.

#### `ConvoHopPushRegistration.register` static method

```swift
@available(iOSApplicationExtension, unavailable)
@available(macCatalystApplicationExtension, unavailable)
@available(macOSApplicationExtension, unavailable)
public static func register(
    options: UNAuthorizationOptions = [.alert, .badge, .sound]
) async throws -> Bool
```

Requests authorization, then registers for remote notifications whatever the user chose.

Returns: Whether the user allows notifications with `options`.

### `ConvoHopPushToken` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopPushToken
```

Device tokens for your backend. ConvoHop never stores them.

Re-exported from `ConvoHopPush`.

#### `ConvoHopPushToken.hex` static method

```swift
public static func hex(_ token: Data) -> String
```

An APNs or PushKit token as lowercase hex, the form APNs requests use.

### `ConvoHopReplayError` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopReplayError: Error, Sendable, Equatable, CustomStringConvertible, LocalizedError
```

A replay that can't continue as requested.

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.resyncRequired` case

```swift
case resyncRequired
```

The authority requires an explicit resynchronization of authorized history. Call
`ConvoHopClient.resyncAuthorizedHistory(_:apply:onError:)`. The cursor is never reset silently.

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.superseded` case

```swift
case superseded
```

A newer resynchronization of the same conversation replaced this replay.

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.workLimitReached` case

```swift
case workLimitReached
```

One round reached its page limit. Call `ConversationStream.reconcile()` again.

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.alreadyStarted` case

```swift
case alreadyStarted
```

The replay was already started or closed.

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.requiresIdle` case

```swift
case requiresIdle
```

Resynchronization needs a new replay that hasn't started.

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.description` property

```swift
public var description: String { get }
```

#### `ConvoHopReplayError.errorDescription` property

```swift
public var errorDescription: String? { get }
```

### `ConvoHopWebSocketEvent` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopWebSocketEvent: Sendable, Equatable
```

An event from a realtime socket. A connection reports `closed` last.

#### `ConvoHopWebSocketEvent.open` case

```swift
case open(protocol: String?)
```

The handshake finished with the negotiated subprotocol.

#### `ConvoHopWebSocketEvent.text` case

```swift
case text(String)
```

#### `ConvoHopWebSocketEvent.binary` case

```swift
case binary(Data)
```

#### `ConvoHopWebSocketEvent.failed` case

```swift
case failed
```

The transport failed. A `closed` event follows.

#### `ConvoHopWebSocketEvent.closed` case

```swift
case closed(code: Int, reason: String = "")
```

The connection ended with a close code and the reason the peer sent, empty without one. A socket should pass
the reason on: the stream classifies a close by the error code that starts it, such as `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`.

### `RecoveryState.Resolution` enum

```swift
public enum Resolution: String, Hashable, Sendable
```

What is known about a recorded mutation.

#### `RecoveryState.Resolution.pending` case

```swift
case pending
```

Recorded but not yet sent.

#### `RecoveryState.Resolution.unknown` case

```swift
case unknown
```

Sent without a receipt. Resolve or retry it with the same request ID.

#### `RecoveryState.Resolution.rejected` case

```swift
case rejected
```

The authority refused every attempt. A retryable refusal, such as `RATE_LIMITED`, can still be retried with
the same request ID while the retry budget lasts.

#### `RecoveryState.Resolution.committed` case

```swift
case committed
```

#### `RecoveryState.Resolution.accepted` case

```swift
case accepted
```

### `SessionRefreshState` enum

```swift
public enum SessionRefreshState: String, Hashable, Sendable
```

Whether a client can renew its session through `ConvoHopConfiguration.refreshSession`.

#### `SessionRefreshState.disabled` case

```swift
case disabled
```

No refresh callback is configured.

#### `SessionRefreshState.uninitialized` case

```swift
case uninitialized
```

`ConvoHopClient.initialize()` hasn't bound the original session yet.

#### `SessionRefreshState.ready` case

```swift
case ready
```

The session is bound and can be renewed.

#### `SessionRefreshState.refreshing` case

```swift
case refreshing
```

A renewal is in progress. Requests wait for it.

#### `SessionRefreshState.blocked` case

```swift
case blocked
```

A renewal could not be verified. Requests fail with `SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED` until the app replaces the client.

## Types

### `ConvoHopSessionRefresh` type

```swift
public typealias ConvoHopSessionRefresh = @Sendable (_ current: Session) async throws -> SessionBootstrap
```

Renews the user's session through your backend.

ConvoHop calls it with the current session. Ask your backend to renew that session with a server SDK and return
the bootstrap it receives. Never put backend keys in the app.

### `JSONObject` type

```swift
public typealias JSONObject = [String: JSONValue]
```

A JSON object.

# `ConvoHopLiveKit`

Call media through the official LiveKit Swift SDK, and CallKit audio session handling on iOS.

**Layer:** Client. **Runtime:** iOS 15 or later, or macOS 12 or later, with LiveKit's `client-sdk-swift` 2.17.0 or later. **Source:** `swift/Sources/ConvoHopLiveKit`.

## Classes

### `LiveKitMediaRoom` class

```swift
public final class LiveKitMediaRoom: NSObject, ConvoHopMediaRoom, @unchecked Sendable
extension LiveKitMediaRoom: RoomDelegate
```

A `ConvoHopMediaRoom` on the official LiveKit Swift SDK.

Each instance connects once. LiveKit resumes a dropped connection itself while its token allows, and reports the
resume; anything else needs `MediaConnection.reconnect()`, which admits a new connection with a new room.

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.room` property

```swift
public let room: Room
```

LiveKit's room, for rendering tracks, reading participants and statistics. Don't connect or disconnect it
yourself, and don't publish the microphone or camera outside `MediaConnection`.

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom` constructor

```swift
public init(roomOptions: RoomOptions = RoomOptions(), reconnectAttempts: Int = 3)
```

Parameters:

- `roomOptions`: LiveKit's room options, such as capture defaults and adaptive stream.
- `reconnectAttempts`: How often LiveKit tries to resume a dropped connection before it gives up.

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.connect` method

```swift
public func connect(
    url: URL,
    token: String,
    iceTransportPolicy: ConvoHopICETransportPolicy,
    onEvent: @escaping @Sendable (ConvoHopMediaRoomEvent) -> Void
) async throws -> String
```

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.setMicrophone` method

```swift
public func setMicrophone(enabled: Bool) async throws
```

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.setCamera` method

```swift
public func setCamera(enabled: Bool) async throws
```

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.disconnect` method

```swift
public func disconnect() async
```

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.room(_:didStartReconnectWithMode:)` method

```swift
public func room(_ room: Room, didStartReconnectWithMode reconnectMode: ReconnectMode)
```

#### `LiveKitMediaRoom.room(_:didCompleteReconnectWithMode:)` method

```swift
public func room(_ room: Room, didCompleteReconnectWithMode reconnectMode: ReconnectMode)
```


## Structs

### `ConvoHopMediaOptions` struct

```swift
extension ConvoHopMediaOptions
```

What `ConvoHopLiveKit` adds to `ConvoHopMediaOptions`, which `ConvoHop` declares.

#### `ConvoHopMediaOptions.liveKit` static method

```swift
public static func liveKit(
    iceTransportPolicy: ConvoHopICETransportPolicy = .all,
    roomOptions: RoomOptions = RoomOptions(),
    reconnectAttempts: Int = 3,
    onDisconnected: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil,
    onResuming: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil,
    onResumed: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil
) -> ConvoHopMediaOptions
```

Connects native media with the official LiveKit Swift SDK.

# `ConvoHopPush`

Push payload parsing, deduplication, the ring ledger and the push recipient, with Foundation only so app extensions can use it.

**Layer:** Client. **Runtime:** iOS 15 or later, or macOS 12 or later, in an app or an app extension. **Source:** `swift/Sources/ConvoHopPush`.

## Classes

### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger` class

```swift
public final class ConvoHopNotificationLedger: @unchecked Sendable
```

Remembers the notification events this device handled and the rings that stopped.

Delivery is at least once and unordered: a redelivered event has the same `eventId`, and a cancellation can arrive
before its ring. Record each event once, and drop a ring the ledger reports as stopped.

Pass the same App Group suite in your app and its Notification Service Extension to share one ledger. Two processes
writing at the same moment can drop an entry, so treat the ledger as best effort. At sign-out, set `recipient` to
`ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody` and call `removeAll()`.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger` constructor

```swift
public init(suiteName: String? = nil, capacity: Int = 512)
```

Parameters:

- `suiteName`: An App Group suite to share with your extensions, or `nil` for the app's standard defaults.
- `capacity`: How many event IDs and stopped rings to remember, at least 16.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.record` method

```swift
@discardableResult
public func record(_ notification: ConvoHopNotification) -> Bool
```

Records the event, and the stopped ring of a cancellation. Returns `false` when the event was already recorded.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.contains` method

```swift
public func contains(eventId: String) -> Bool
```

Whether the event was recorded.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.markStopped` method

```swift
public func markStopped(_ alert: ConvoHopCallAlert, reason: ConvoHopCallEndReason)
```

Records that a ring stopped, for example when your app ended it.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.stopReason` method

```swift
public func stopReason(alertId: String) -> ConvoHopCallEndReason?
```

Why the ring stopped, if a cancellation or stop was recorded for its `alertId`.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.isStopped` method

```swift
public func isStopped(_ alert: ConvoHopCallAlert, at now: Date = Date()) -> Bool
```

Whether the ring has stopped: a cancellation was recorded or its deadline has passed.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.recipient` property

```swift
public var recipient: ConvoHopPushRecipient { get set }
```

Whose pushes this device rings for and shows. `ConvoHopPushRecipient.any` until you set one.

It's stored in the ledger's suite, so a Notification Service Extension that shares the suite, and your app
after a relaunch, see it. A stored value this version can't read counts as `ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody`.

#### `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.removeAll` method

```swift
public func removeAll()
```

Forgets every event and ring. It keeps `recipient`.

The call ended or stopped ringing first: a missed call.

#### `ConvoHopCallEndReason.expired` static property

### `ConvoHopNotification` struct

```swift
public struct ConvoHopNotification: Sendable, Hashable
```

A ConvoHop notification event from an APNs, PushKit or FCM payload.

Events carry identifiers and, only when the project opts in to message previews, visible text. Delivery is at
least once and unordered: deduplicate on `eventId` with `ConvoHopNotificationLedger`.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.eventId` property

```swift
public let eventId: String
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.eventType` property

```swift
public let eventType: String
```

`notification.message`, `notification.call` or `notification.callCancelled`.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.projectId` property


#### `ConvoHopNotification.recipientId` property


```swift

```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.senderId` property

```swift

```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.occurredAt` property

```swift
public let occurredAt: Date
```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.title` property

```swift
public let title: String?
```

The visible title, if the push carries one.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.body` property

```swift

```

The visible body, if the push carries one: your backend's text or, when the project opts in, the message
preview. Absent by default.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.kind` property

```swift

```

#### `ConvoHopNotification.callAlert` property

```swift
public var callAlert: ConvoHopCallAlert? { get }
```

The ring, for calls and cancellations.

#### `ConvoHopNotification` constructor

```swift
public init?(userInfo: [AnyHashable: Any])
public init(jsonObject: Any) throws
public init(jsonData: Data) throws
```

Reads the `convohop` object of a push's `userInfo`, and the visible text of an APNs alert.

Returns `nil` when the push has no valid `convohop` object or it isn't a notification event this SDK supports.
Fields the contract doesn't define are ignored.

Validates a `convohop` object: a dictionary, or its JSON text as FCM data carries it.

Validates the JSON text of a `convohop` object.

#### `ConvoHopNotification.parse` static method

```swift
public static func parse(userInfo: [AnyHashable: Any]) throws -> ConvoHopNotification?
```

Reads a push's `userInfo` like `init(userInfo:)`, but throws `ConvoHopPushPayloadError` when the `convohop`
object is malformed.

Returns `nil` when the push has no `convohop` object or its event type isn't one this SDK supports.

### `ConvoHopPushRecipient` enum

```swift
public enum ConvoHopPushRecipient: Sendable, Hashable
```

Whose ConvoHop pushes this device rings for and shows.

Set it at sign-in to the signed-in user, and to `nobody` at sign-out: your backend can still hold the device's
tokens, and their pushes keep arriving. Store it with `ConvoHopNotificationLedger.recipient`, or set
`ConvoHopCalls.recipient`, so your Notification Service Extension and a relaunch for a VoIP push see it.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.any` case

```swift
case any
```

Every ConvoHop push. The default until you set a recipient.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.only` case

```swift
case only(projectId: String, recipientId: String)
```

Only pushes for this user in this project.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody` case

```swift
case nobody
```

No ConvoHop push, for example after sign-out.

#### `ConvoHopPushRecipient.accepts` method

```swift
public func accepts(_ notification: ConvoHopNotification) -> Bool
```

Whether the push is for this recipient.

```swift
public enum ConvoHopPushToken
```

Device tokens for your backend. ConvoHop never stores them.

#### `ConvoHopPushToken.hex` static method

```swift
public static func hex(_ token: Data) -> String
```

An APNs or PushKit token as lowercase hex, the form APNs requests use.

# `ConvoHopCalls`

Incoming calls from PushKit VoIP pushes to CallKit, and outgoing calls through CallKit.

**Layer:** Client. **Runtime:** iOS 15 or later. On macOS it has only the call model. **Source:** `swift/Sources/ConvoHopCalls`.

## Classes

### `ConvoHopCalls` class

```swift
@MainActor
public final class ConvoHopCalls: NSObject
extension ConvoHopCalls: PKPushRegistryDelegate
extension ConvoHopCalls: CXProviderDelegate
```

Reports ConvoHop calls to CallKit and receives VoIP pushes through PushKit.

Call `start(configuration:delegate:)` in `application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)`: iOS can launch your
app for a VoIP push, and terminates an app that doesn't report each one to CallKit. This class reports every VoIP
push. A push it doesn't ring for, such as one for someone other than `recipient`, is reported and ended at once.

Answered and declined rings get no push. When realtime or `ConvoHopClient.ringStopReason(_:)` shows that a ringing
call stopped, call `end(_:reason:)` with the reason.

Available on iOS only.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.shared` static property

```swift
public static let shared = ConvoHopCalls()
```

#### `ConvoHopCalls.delegate` property

```swift
public private(set) weak var delegate: ConvoHopCallsDelegate?
```

#### `ConvoHopCalls.configuration` property

```swift
public private(set) var configuration: ConvoHopCallsConfiguration
```

#### `ConvoHopCalls.ledger` property

```swift
public private(set) var ledger: ConvoHopNotificationLedger
```

Remembers handled pushes and stopped rings. Share its suite with your Notification Service Extension.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.voipToken` property

```swift
public private(set) var voipToken: Data?
```

The PushKit VoIP token, once iOS issued one.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.recipient` property

```swift
public var recipient: ConvoHopPushRecipient { get set }
```

Whose calls ring. `ConvoHopPushRecipient.any` until you set one.

Set `.only(projectId:recipientId:)` at sign-in and `ConvoHopPushRecipient.nobody` at sign-out. It's
stored in the ledger's suite, so it holds when iOS relaunches your app for a VoIP push, and a Notification
Service Extension on the same suite hides the text of other users' pushes.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.calls` property

```swift
public var calls: [ConvoHopCall] { get }
```

The calls, oldest first. An ended call stays for a minute.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.start` method

```swift
public func start(
    configuration: ConvoHopCallsConfiguration = ConvoHopCallsConfiguration(),
    delegate: ConvoHopCallsDelegate?
)
```

Sets up CallKit and PushKit. Call it again to change the configuration or delegate.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.handle` method

```swift
public func handle(_ notification: ConvoHopNotification)
```

Handles a ConvoHop notification that arrived outside PushKit, such as an alert push.

A ring rings in CallKit unless it already rang, stopped or expired. A cancellation ends the ringing call,
records the stop and removes delivered notifications for the ring.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.startOutgoingCall` method

```swift
@discardableResult
public func startOutgoingCall(
    liveSessionId: String,
    conversationId: String,
    handle: String? = nil,
    displayName: String? = nil,
    hasVideo: Bool = false
) async throws -> UUID
```

Starts an outgoing call in CallKit. Start the live session with ConvoHop first.

Parameters:

- `handle`: What CallKit shows and stores in Recents. Defaults to the conversation ID.

Returns: The CallKit UUID.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.reportConnecting` method

```swift
public func reportConnecting(_ uuid: UUID)
```

Reports that media connects for an answered or outgoing call.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.reportConnected` method

```swift
public func reportConnected(_ uuid: UUID)
```

Reports that media connected for an answered or outgoing call.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.update` method

```swift
public func update(_ uuid: UUID, localizedCallerName: String? = nil, hasVideo: Bool? = nil)
```

Updates what CallKit shows for a call.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.answer` method

```swift
public func answer(_ uuid: UUID) async throws
```

Asks CallKit to answer a ringing call, for example from an in-app Answer button.
`ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didAnswer:)` follows, as when the user answers in the system UI.

Throws: `CXErrorCodeRequestTransactionError.unknownCallUUID` for a call ConvoHop didn't report, or
`.invalidAction` for a call that isn't ringing, before asking CallKit.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.setMuted` method

```swift
public func setMuted(_ muted: Bool, for uuid: UUID) async throws
```

Asks CallKit to mute or unmute. `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didSetMuted:for:)` applies it.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.setHeld` method

```swift
public func setHeld(_ onHold: Bool, for uuid: UUID) async throws
```

Asks CallKit to hold or resume. `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didSetHeld:for:)` applies it.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.end` method

```swift
public func end(_ uuid: UUID, reason: ConvoHopCallEndReason? = nil) async throws
```

Ends a call.

Parameters:

- `reason`: `nil` when the user ends the call in your app, which asks CallKit to end it. Otherwise
  why the call stopped elsewhere, for example `answered` when another device answered the ring.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.forget` method

```swift
@discardableResult
public func forget(_ uuid: UUID) -> Bool
```

Forgets an ended call before its minute is up. Returns `false` for a call that hasn't ended.

#### `ConvoHopCalls.addObserver` method

```swift
public func addObserver(
    _ handler: @escaping @MainActor ([ConvoHopCall]) -> Void
) -> ConvoHopCallsObservation
```

Calls `handler` with `calls` now and whenever they change, until you cancel or release the observation.

## Interfaces

### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate` interface

```swift
@MainActor
public protocol ConvoHopCallsDelegate: AnyObject
```

Receives what CallKit and PushKit report. Every method has an empty default.

Available on iOS only.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didUpdateVoIPToken:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didUpdateVoIPToken token: Data?)
```

Send the VoIP token, as `ConvoHopPushToken.hex(_:)`, to your backend, which sends VoIP pushes for calls.
ConvoHop never stores device tokens. `nil` means iOS invalidated the token: remove it from your backend.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didReceiveIncomingCall:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didReceiveIncomingCall call: ConvoHopCall)
```

A call rings in CallKit.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didAnswer:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didAnswer call: ConvoHopCall)
```

The user answered. Join the live session, connect media and call `reportConnected(_:)`.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didStartOutgoing:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didStartOutgoing call: ConvoHopCall)
```

CallKit started the call from `startOutgoingCall(liveSessionId:conversationId:handle:displayName:hasVideo:)`.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didEnd:reason:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(
    _ calls: ConvoHopCalls,
    didEnd call: ConvoHopCall,
    reason: ConvoHopCallEndReason?
)
```

The call ended. `reason` is `nil` when the user ended or declined it. Leave the call and disconnect media.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didSetMuted:for:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didSetMuted muted: Bool, for call: ConvoHopCall)
```

Mute or unmute the microphone. This is the only place to do it, for the system UI and for your app.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didSetHeld:for:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didSetHeld onHold: Bool, for call: ConvoHopCall)
```

Hold or resume the call.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didActivate:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didActivate audioSession: AVAudioSession)
```

CallKit activated the audio session. Start call audio now, not before.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCalls(_:didDeactivate:)` method

```swift
func convoHopCalls(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls, didDeactivate audioSession: AVAudioSession)
```

CallKit deactivated the audio session.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

#### `ConvoHopCallsDelegate.convoHopCallsDidReset` method

```swift
func convoHopCallsDidReset(_ calls: ConvoHopCalls)
```

CallKit reset. Every call ended as `failed`, and `convoHopCalls(_:didEnd:reason:)` ran for each.

Has a default implementation, so conforming types may omit it.

